{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
# Keep only completed orders that are not QA orders
df_real_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue for real completed orders
mean_revenue_real_completed = df_real_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of real completed orders: {len(df_real_completed)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue_real_completed}")"}
